parsed.name: 高重复频率像增强器
parsed.description: 这是一种高重复频率、可门控的像增强器，采用微通道板（MCP）进行弱光放大，并支持外部触发、门控模式和增益相关设置。它常用于高速或时间分辨光学实验中，对瞬态发光、激光诱导过程等弱光信号进行同步增强成像。
parsed.description_en: A high-repetition-rate gated image intensifier that uses a microchannel plate (MCP) to amplify low-light optical signals, with external triggering, gating modes, and gain-related settings. It is commonly used in high-speed or time-resolved optical experiments to synchronously intensify and image transient emission and other weak-light phenomena.
